1.name: Finding a Voice (1946 – 1979)
1.overview: Against the backdrop of a politically charged South Africa, where censorship tightened its grip on the airwaves, we trace Anton Goosen’s early journey from frustrated teacher and aspiring songwriter to musical breakthrough. His rise culminates in a hit song and the release of Boy van die Suburbs—the first Afrikaans album entirely written and performed by a single artist.

1.name: Rapid Fame (1980 – 1986)
1.overview: Anton Goosen’s meteoric rise to fame brought admiration, controversy and intense scrutiny. We explore the impact of his music on the establishment, his role in movements such as Musiek en Liriek, and his defiance of convention. His remarkable 1986 comeback with City/Stad saw Anton once again challenging expectations and pushing boundaries in a volatile South Africa.

1.name: Defiance & Reinvention (1987 – 2000)
1.overview: As political unrest grips South Africa, Anton risks everything to challenge Apartheid, joining progressive Afrikaners in engaging with the banned ANC. Through his music, he becomes a voice of defiance, while the Voëlvry Movement inspires a new generation. Post-Apartheid, his landmark album Danzer (1992), featuring Lucky Dube, breaks musical barriers and makes history. After years of relentless creativity, Anton takes a sabbatical before embarking on new ventures in the new millennium.

1.name: The Endless River (2000 – 2025)
1.overview: Anton makes a triumphant return with the SAMA-winning Vis innie Bos, followed by sold-out shows and projects celebrating collaboration and emerging talent. International tours bring new experiences, including meeting his partner Estie, before a traumatic farm attack prompts a move to the coast and a new creative beginning. A string of acclaimed releases culminates in Sirkels (2024). Anton continues to tour and create, proving that his passion for music remains undiminished.

overview: This powerful four-part documentary series explores the life and legacy of South Africa’s musical icon, Anton Goosen. From his early defiance against Apartheid’s censorship to his groundbreaking success and influence on Afrikaans rock, it captures Goosen’s remarkable journey. With rare interviews, lost footage, key performances, and rise to fame, it chronicles his revolutionary impact on the music scene – shaping South African culture and music over five decades.
